description:
## X Patch 1.12.1-x.2 (2026-10-30)

* Copy media URL: copy the direct video file URL from X's video download action, or continue with Save video.
* Also copies direct photo, video and GIF URLs from post options.
* Retains Fix external post links, Hide Find more and Hide Who to follow.
* Supports X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01. Android UI and APK-level behavior for the new video action are not yet verified.
* Image long-press and image-viewer overflow menu entry points remain unimplemented.
